content.text: You're an entrepreneur in Nigeria locked out of Gumroad. Your USDT sales are delayed due to Stripe's unavailability in Venezuela. In Zimbabwe, your customers can't use PayPal. The problem is clear: conventional platforms are failing you. This guide shows how to set up a NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-costing-you|Why Payment]]s [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-costing|digital]] store that works around these restrictions, so you can deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure today.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

NOWPayments supports over 300 [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]currencies across multiple blockchain networks. For practical digital product sales, the most operationally useful options are USDT on Tron — fastest settlement under 60 seconds, fees under $0.10, widely held in restricted markets — USDT on Ethereum — higher fees but the most widely supported chain globally — Bitcoin — highest global recognition, 10 to 60 minute confirmation depending on network congestion — Solana — fast settlement, fees of fractions of a cent, growing adoption — and BNB on Binance Smart Chain — popular in Southeast Asia and widely available through Binance.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, make sure you have a GitHub account, a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account, a Supabase or Google Sheets account, and a NOWPayments account. You'll also need a payment method like USDT or Bitcoin. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get all six blueprints and seven templates to help you build, deploy, and scale your sovereign commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment pipeline, create a NOWPayments account and connect your preferred cryptocurrency wallet. Configure automatic webhook notifications to trigger when on-chain payments are confirmed. For delivery, set up Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages to host your store, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to handle file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets will store your orders, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script will handle backend logic.
This infrastructure is designed to work around platform restrictions, not rent from them.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live, deploy your sovereign commerce stack, configure your store with products and payment information, and test your payments and delivery pipeline. This typically takes a few hours. Once live, process your first transaction by making an on-chain payment to your store, and then verifying the payment in your NOWPayments dashboard. Transaction fees on Tron and Solana average under $0.10 and fractions of a cent, respectively.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
USDT on Tron and Solana transaction fees average under $0.10 and fractions of a cent, respectively.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: 1. Set up a GitHub, Google Drive, Supabase, and NOWPayments account. 2. Connect your cryptocurrency wallet to NOWPayments. 3. Configure automatic webhook notifications. 4. Deploy your Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages store. 5. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. 6. Configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. 7. Deploy Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. 8. Test your payments and delivery pipeline.

You can receive crypto payments for your digital products by connecting your cryptocurrency wallet to NOWPayments and configuring automatic webhook notifications. This ensures secure, on-chain payments and triggers notifications when payments are confirmed.
